text.p: Typhoon Nestor is now west of the northern Mariana islands. Top winds are now 130 mph. This system is expected to be close to Iwo Jima in 24 hours with winds up to 120 mph and close to Chichi Jima in 36 hours with winds of 110 mph. These islands can except flooding rains and very strong winds. Damage could be quite high. This system will also threaten shipping as it moves between these islands as seas still exceed 20 feet near the center of this system.

Tropical Storm Blanca, with 45 mph winds, is 300 miles south of Manzanillo Mexico, moving west-northwest at 15 mph. It is expected to move away from Mexico while strengthening, becoming less of a threat to Mexico and more of a threat to shipping. It could turn towards the southern tip of Baja in about 72 hours.

Tropical Cyclone Keli, with 75 mph winds, is in the southern Pacific near 12s/178.5e, moving southwest at 8 mph. Strengthening is expected as Keli turns to the south the next 36 hours, threatening only shipping.
